scope: Material risk groups covering all 33 directive attacks plus company, institutional and human failure. This is not a completed threat-model implementation or an aggregate risk score.

risks.status: open; controls specified or being specified, no implementation proof
risks.title: Untrusted content becomes authority
risks.cause: Retrieved pages, tool metadata or model messages masquerade as instructions, grants or corroboration.
risks.likelihood_or_uncertainty: Plausible adversarial or operational sequence; frequency unmeasured. No numeric probability inferred from conceptual review.
risks.consequence: Unauthorized work, changed recipients, disclosure or commitments.
risks.prevention: Separate attributed data from authenticated commands; protected tool schemas and grants determine effect semantics.
risks.detection: Inject instructions and forged tool annotations while comparing proposed work and actual release against independent policy.
risks.containment: Suspend affected producer/tool scope, preserve raw evidence and revalidate every dependent proposal.
risks.rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
risks.residual_risk: Misleading content may still influence judgment within an allowed proposal scope; perfect model compliance is not assumed.

risks.likelihood_or_uncertainty: Plausible adversarial or operational sequence; frequency unmeasured. No numeric probability inferred from conceptual review.

risks.rollback_or_compensation: Restore compatible internal state only after current authority, effects and restrictions are reconciled. External effects require an independently authorized correction, remedy or legitimate disposition; reversal is not assumed.
risks.residual_risk: A stolen credential can exercise real native permissions until containment; unenumerable routes keep the scope contained.
